fix: stabilize camellia login and shared session shell (#48)

## Summary
- add a shared light/dark/system theme system for camellia and surface it in login and the console shell
- redesign the login page around a primary credential flow with token bootstrap moved into an explicit advanced section
- unify `SessionSettings` and user-domain routes onto the same camellia session store and keep the console visible during session refresh
- replace the dashboard's migration/deferred placeholder copy with runtime-focused session and route entry information

## Testing
- pnpm run typecheck:camellia
- pnpm run build:camellia
- pnpm run smoke:camellia:deploy
- curl -sS http://localhost:3100/login | rg "Sign in to the admin console|System|Nothing is prefilled"

## Blockers
- post-login manual QA against staging is still blocked by missing valid admin credentials/token; the hardcoded `master/passwd` sample currently returns `账户或密码错误`

Refs DAM-46
